gloss: foot bath; soaking one's feet in hot water

definitions.gloss: foot bath; soaking one's feet in hot water
definitions.explanation: Soaking the feet and lower legs in warm or hot water, either as a relaxing home practice or as a therapeutic and nursing procedure. Popular at hot-spring resorts as a {足湯|あしゆ} facility and also used in healthcare settings to warm patients who cannot take a full bath.

⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{足浴|そくよく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}り→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧やすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Taking a foot bath before bed makes it easier to fall asleep.

examples.japanese: {入院中|にゅういんちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入浴|にゅうよく}→入浴：11642_nyuuyoku⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{足浴|そくよく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}って→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: Even for hospitalized patients who cannot take a bath, nurses will perform a foot bath for them.

notes:
Sino-Japanese compound of ⟦{足|そく}→足：00992_soku⟧ ('foot') and {浴|よく} ('bathing'). A somewhat technical term used especially in healthcare, nursing, and wellness contexts. In everyday conversation the native Japanese word ⟦{足湯|あしゆ}→足湯：14296_ashiyu⟧ is far more common, especially at hot-spring resorts and roadside rest stops.

USAGE:
- Most common in nursing, eldercare, and medical writing, where it names a standard care procedure for warming patients, improving circulation, or promoting sleep.
- Also appears in wellness and sleep-hygiene articles recommending a foot bath as a home remedy.
- Takes ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb: {足浴|そくよく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ('to do a foot bath'), but {足浴|そくよく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ and {足浴|そくよく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ are equally common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {足浴|そくよく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take a foot bath
- {足浴|そくよく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to perform a foot bath (clinical register)
- {足浴|そくよく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: the effects of a foot bath
- {手浴|しゅよく}・{足浴|そくよく}: hand bath and foot bath (paired care term)
- ⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧{足浴|そくよく}: a warm foot bath

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{足湯|あしゆ}→足湯：14296_ashiyu⟧: foot bath — native Japanese word; refers especially to public hot-spring foot-bath facilities, and more casual in tone.
- ⟦{入浴|にゅうよく}→入浴：11642_nyuuyoku⟧: bathing — general word for taking a bath; contrasted with {足浴|そくよく} in nursing contexts when a full bath is not possible.
- {手浴|しゅよく}: hand bath — soaking the hands in warm water, a parallel nursing procedure.
- {半身浴|はんしんよく}: half-body bath — soaking the body up to the waist only, a popular wellness practice.
- {温浴|おんよく}: warm bathing — broader term covering any warm-water bathing for therapeutic purposes.
